name: County Controller
summary: Audit turnaround and payroll processing efficiency need significant improvement

recommendations.title: Implement Continuous Auditing Software
recommendations.description: Deploy automated audit software to continuously monitor transactions instead of periodic manual reviews.
actions: Evaluate IDEA, ACL, or TeamMate audit software
Train staff on continuous auditing methodology

recommendations.title: Streamline Voucher Pre-Audit Process
recommendations.description: Reduce voucher review time from 15 to 8 minutes through standardized checklists and delegation.
actions: Delegate routine vouchers to trained staff

recommendations.title: Automate Payroll Processing
recommendations.description: Reduce payroll cycle time by automating time entry validation and tax calculations.
actions: Implement direct deposit for remaining paper checks

recommendations.title: Establish Audit Finding Tracking System
recommendations.description: Track audit findings from identification through resolution to improve follow-up rates.
actions: Establish escalation procedures for overdue findings

recommendations.title: Improve Board Meeting Preparation
recommendations.description: Reduce board report preparation time through templates and advance data gathering.
actions: Establish reporting calendar with advance deadlines
Cross-train staff on board report preparation
